'''Mar'gavrok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Flesh Raider]] warrior who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They made their home atop the [[Matriarch's Summit]], near the [[Kolovish's tower|tower]] of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]]' former [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Mar'gavrok was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-allied individual who was visiting the former Matriarch on a ritual known as "The Thousand Steps".

==Behind the scenes==
Mar'gavrok first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Mar'gavrok is not a main asset of any quest, but can be killed for loot. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means they were killed.
